key_concepts: The menstrual cycle averages 28 days and prepares the female body for possible pregnancy
Menstruation is the normal monthly shedding of the uterine lining from puberty until menop
Menstrual phase occurs days 1–5 and sheds the endometrium as menstrual fluid
Dysmenorrhea is painful menstruation caused by uterine and abdominal contractions
Follicular phase occurs days 1–13 as estrogen thickens the uterine lining
FSH from the pituitary stimulates egg cells to mature in ovarian follicles
Ovulation usually occurs on day 14 when a mature ovum is released
Fimbriae and cilia guide the ovum into the fallopian tube
Fertilization must occur within 24 hours after ovulation
Luteal phase occurs days 15–28 when corpus luteum secretes progesterone
If no fertilization, the uterine lining breaks down and the cycle repeats until menopause
Proper menstrual hygiene includes bathing daily, changing pads regularly, and wearing clea
